A real Hidden Gem!
Nov 2025 • Couples
Hidden in the narrow streets, you will find a true gem here – and not only for lovers of Asian cuisine. The restaurant is completely vegetarian, but nothing is really missing. On the contrary: We could hardly decide between all the creative and delicious dishes. Everything from burgers to spirulina salad is included – vegetarian or vegan, of course.

A special highlight is the homemade “Happy Beef Jerky” made from mushrooms: completely without chemicals or glutamate, but refined with wonderful spices. And if you like to try new things, you will find exciting ingredients on the menu that will make every biohacker's heart beat faster - such as lion's mane mushroom or fermented teas.

The staff is enchanting and makes you feel welcome immediately.
We will definitely come back!

Padme Chay – A Vegetarian Paradise of Flavor and Aesthetic Vibes!
May 2025 • Friends
Padme Chay is truly a wonderful culinary experience! Although the dishes are vegetarian, the flavors are rich and satisfying—just like eating savory, non-vegetarian food. Every dish is carefully prepared, not only delicious but also healthy and nourishing. The restaurant space is absolutely stunning, beautifully decorated with a modern touch. Every corner is Instagram-worthy—just point your camera and you’ve got a perfect shot. It’s definitely an ideal spot for anyone who loves vegetarian cuisine and enjoys taking beautiful photos!

One of very best vegetarian restaurants in the WORLD !
Mar 2025 • Friends
Vietnam has some of the most innovative and delicious vegetarian restaurants in the world (both in HCMC and Hanoi), and Padme Chay is by far the best! There are dishes here that I have not seen anywhere else, and such a variety too - in terms of textures, tastes, and plating. If possible, go with a big group so you can try more dishes. Hidden in small side street, so not obvious to expats. However, it’s a few minutes walk from the Vĩnh Nghiêm pagoda, so well patronized by Vietnamese clientele.
